queries.rationale: The canonical title for the first target role.
The most common synonym employers post under.
Product companies on Greenhouse use this title.
Used by services firms for the same work.
Catches GenAI roles filed under ML.
Stack-anchored on the strongest evidence in the profile.
Seniority variant the candidate can win.

jobs.title: Generative AI Developer (Entry Level)
jobs.description_excerpt: Build and ship retrieval-augmented features for our support product.
jobs.description: Lumen Forge AI builds support automation for SaaS companies. We are hiring an entry-level Generative AI Developer to build and ship retrieval-augmented features for our support product. You will write Python services with FastAPI, build RAG pipelines with LangChain, and measure answer quality before every release. Must have: Python, hands-on RAG experience, LangChain, FastAPI. Nice to have: Docker, a vector database such as pgvector or Pinecone, AWS. 0-1 years of experience. Internship experience counts. Fully remote within India. Compensation: INR 6-9 LPA.

jobs.title: Junior AI Engineer
jobs.description_excerpt: Own the evaluation harness for our LLM features.
jobs.description: Orbitline Systems makes workflow software for logistics teams. As a Junior AI Engineer you will own the evaluation harness for our LLM features and turn prompt experiments into production code. Requirements: Python, experience calling LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and writing evaluations that catch hallucinations before release. 1 year of experience, internships included. Bonus: agents and tool calling, TypeScript. Remote, any time zone that overlaps four hours with IST.

jobs.title: Associate LLM Application Developer
jobs.description_excerpt: Build agentic document workflows on AWS.
jobs.description: Paperkite Software automates document workflows for finance teams. You will build agentic document workflows on AWS: LangChain agents that call tools, deployed on Lambda with Amazon Bedrock. Required: Python, LangChain, hands-on experience building agents with tool calling, and hands-on AWS (Lambda, S3, Bedrock). Nice to have: Kubernetes, TypeScript. 0-2 years of experience. Remote within India.

jobs.title: Python Backend Developer I
jobs.description_excerpt: Build and test REST APIs for our accounting platform.
jobs.description: Tallyroot builds accounting software for small businesses. As a Python Backend Developer I you will build and test REST APIs for our accounting platform. Must have: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, and automated testing with pytest. Nice to have: Redis, CI/CD. 0-1 years of experience. Remote. Salary: INR 5-7 LPA.

jobs.title: ML Engineer - GenAI (Graduate)
jobs.description_excerpt: Fine-tune and evaluate open-weight language models.
jobs.description: Quillstack Labs trains writing models for publishers. Graduate ML Engineers fine-tune and evaluate open-weight language models. Required: Python, PyTorch, hands-on fine-tuning (LoRA or full), Hugging Face Transformers. Nice to have: RAG, Docker. Open to 2026 graduates. Remote.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description_excerpt: Design RAG solutions on AWS with enterprise customers.
jobs.description: Harborlight Cloud is an AWS consulting partner. AI Solutions Engineers design RAG solutions on AWS with enterprise customers and present them to technical buyers. Required: Python, 2 years of hands-on AWS, RAG, and customer-facing experience. Nice to have: Terraform. Remote.
